stances.hold: Hold: fight to the last unit.
stances.fall-back: Fall back: retreat if the win chance drops below {threshold}.
stances.evade: Evade: slip away before the fight if the attacker is stronger and no faster; otherwise fall back at 50%.

capture.occupy: Keep the city and its income.
capture.pillage: Take {gold} gold now. The city drops a tier; a village is razed.
capture.raze: Destroy it so nobody can use it.
